_comment: Trigger fixtures for test-trigger-e2e.mjs. Each case feeds `phrase` to `opencode run` and asserts the agent's first tool_use is `skill` with input.name === expectedSkill. Phrases are intentionally clear and unambiguous — if Haiku doesn't trigger on these, neither will it on real-world phrasing.
